data.name: Magehold Online
data.detailed_description:
Forge your own magic. Fight your own battles.

Magehold Online is a multiplayer PVP arena battle game where every ability is crafted by the players themselves. Instead of a fixed spellbook, you build your own arsenal from the ground up, combining elemental forces, shaping them into physical forms, and unleashing them in chaotic battles.

Choose from five elemental powers! Fire, water, ice, air, and stone. Then shape them into five unique forms: dagger, sphere, disk, dome, or wall. Adjust the size, density, and energy of each creation, then bind forces to fling them, ride them, or have them explode upon your enemies. Each spell can summon up to five conjured objects, giving you near-limitless room for experimentation.

Then take your creations into intense 4v4 and 8v8 PVP arena battles, where players clash using only the abilities they’ve designed. Every duel becomes a test of creativity, timing, and strategy. No two fights ever play out the same.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Requires stable internet connection for online multiplayer
